title: Meier introducing Nordics to Arab leaders

tellings.quote: is that the people who were involved with Billy Meyer in the years where he was acting as a super spy working the Middle East say that he introduced these tall, very good-looking Nordic people to the Arab leaders

plain: Billy Meier, a Swiss man who says he has been in contact with aliens, is said to have worked as a spy in the Middle East in the 1970s and to have introduced Arab leaders to "Nordics," tall, very good-looking aliens who look human. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this from the people who worked with Meier in those years, crediting the book Closer Encounters. If true, it would mean human-looking visitors were meeting heads of state in secret.
